name: Hive Publish
author: ULPI Studios
description: Automates DMs on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and Telegram, plus a link in bio page, a shared inbox with roles and approvals, publishing and scheduling to ten networks, and every connected account's analytics in one view. Reads and drafts run immediately. Anything that reaches a real person is confirmed first by the person's own AI client, and a workspace can additionally switch on Hive approvals so the action waits for a person to approve the exact arguments on a page inside Hive. Free for 14 days, no card. Then $6 per connected account per month on Worker Bee, $12 on Swarm, or $85 a month flat on Queen Bee. Unlimited contacts, priced per connected account. Prices: https://hivepublish.com/pricing.json

tools.name: add_competitor
tools.description: Resolve a public competitor through an official provider API and store the first snapshot.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running asynchronous job created by this API connection.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled_post
tools.description: This reaches a real person, so it is confirmed first by the person's own AI client. If the workspace has also switched on Hive approvals, the first call returns a single-use link instead and the action waits until the person approves the exact arguments on a page inside Hive; repeat the exact request with approvalToken and an Idempotency-Key once they have. The AI can never approve itself.

tools.name: create_simple_automation
tools.description: Build one of the six Hive Publish simple automations as a DRAFT on a connected account. It never goes live and never messages anyone: it writes the automation, then reports in plain words everything that still blocks Go Live.

linkUrl.description: The destination the link message opens.

askFollow.description: Switch on the step that asks the person to follow first.

followUp.description: Switch on the later follow-up message.

followUpText.description: The words of that follow-up message.

emailPrompt.description: The words used when asking for the email address.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: The privacy policy shown with the email ask.
